svg.title: Tailor — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as tailor, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A headless tailoring dress form on its stand is paired with a loose measuring tape. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, an oval face.
